jobs.description:
Head of Real Estate

• Full-time

Company Description

Are you ready to take on one of the most ambitious challenges within Corporate Real Estate Management? Do you have the leadership skills, technical insight, and international mindset needed to drive the implementation of JYSK’s Smart Store initiative across 29 countries?

As Head of Real Estate you will play a key role in shaping how JYSK works with building automation, energy management, and operational excellence across our store portfolio. Based at our Head Office in Aarhus, you will establish and develop a newly created function while leading initiatives that support JYSK’s continued growth and expansion.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

This is a unique opportunity to build and lead a new Centre of Excellence within JYSK Real Estate. You will join an international and informal environment characterised by strong teamwork, short decision-making processes, and a high level of responsibility. Reporting to the Expansion Director, Real Estate, you will work closely with colleagues across countries and functions while leading the most ambitious project in JYSK Real Estate ever, the Smart Stores Initiative.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• A unique opportunity to establish and develop a new function with high visibility across the organisation

• A key role in delivering the Smart Store initiative across JYSK’s international store network

• Professional and personal development in a growing international retail company

• A dedicated and experienced leadership team that values collaboration and knowledge sharing

• A modern workplace at our Head Office in Aarhus

• Attractive staff benefits and special discounts within the Lars Larsen Group

• Internal training and development opportunities to support your continued growth

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

In this role, you will be responsible for transforming strategic ambitions into operational standards and scalable solutions. You will lead the development of JYSK’s Centre of Excellence within Real Estate and ensure that building automation, energy management, and Smart Store technologies are implemented consistently across countries.

The position includes approximately 4-6 travel days per month and involves close collaboration with stakeholders throughout the organisation.

Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

• Establishing and leading the Real Estate Center of Excellence

• Driving the implementation and continuous development of the Smart Store initiative across 29 countries

• Defining and maintaining standards, guidelines, and execution models for building solutions

• Leading initiatives within energy management and building automation to improve operational performance

• Supporting ISO-related processes and ensuring alignment between strategy and operational execution

• Acting as a member of the Real Estate Leadership Team and contributing to strategic decision-making

• Providing leadership and professional guidance to both Head Office teams and matrix stakeholders across countries

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

You are an experienced leader who can combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You are comfortable working in an international environment and know how to create alignment across multiple stakeholders. At the same time, you bring strong technical knowledge and a structured approach to implementing complex solutions.

Ideally, we are looking for a new colleague who:

• Has more than 10 years of relevant professional experience, preferably from an international organisation

• Holds an engineering degree or a similar technical qualification within Electrical Engineering, HVAC, Building Automation, or a related discipline

• Has extensive experience with building automation systems, energy management, and technical building solutions

• Has strong project management capabilities and a track record of delivering complex international projects

• Understands operational excellence, ISO standards, and the conversion of strategy into measurable actions

• Is an engaging leader who can develop teams and build strong relationships across functions and countries

• Has experience working with energy management systems, building management systems, and standard business applications

Additional Information

IS THIS YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY? Apply today!

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Expansion Director Real Estate, Søren Prahl at +45 28 92 29 78.

We kindly ask you to only attach your CV. With us, there is no need to write a traditional cover letter when applying for a job.

Instead, when you click “I’m interested/Apply”, you will have the option to write a brief message to the hiring team. If you wish, you can use this space to share your motivation for applying or highlight anything else you feel is relevant.

ABOUT US

We believe our employees are key to our success. That is why we strive to offer development and possibilities of growing and finding new challenges within JYSK. Since our founder, Lars Larsen, opened his first store in Denmark in 1979, JYSK has expanded our global presence with stores and web shops in countries around the world.

Our three fundamental JYSK Values – Tradesman, Colleague and Corporate Spirit – express the behaviour and attitude that we can expect from each other. We trust each other, and we believe in Empowerment and freedom with responsibility. We also take pride in rewarding engagement and a great effort among our employees. With the right attitude, opportunities abound in JYSK.

JYSK wants to include everyone, no matter the age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, ethnicity, and experience. Together, we secure our inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. Because a great mix of minds, talents and unique personalities makes us a stronger team.

For more information, please visit our career page.

CABIN CREW SAS

City:  Kastrup

Cabin Crew Opportunities at SAS

Join SAS Cabin Crew – Opportunities Across Scandinavia

SAS is expanding—connecting people, cultures, and destinations like never before, and we invite you to be part of the journey.

We are now recruiting Cabin Crew - Air Hosts/ Hostesses on different base locations across Scandinavia and also Air Stewards in Copenhagen.

• Copenhagen

• Stockholm

• Oslo

• Bergen

By joining SAS, you will become part of a passionate team dedicated to safety, service, and creating memorable travel experiences for our customers every day.

As Cabin Crew at SAS, you will meet people from all around the world while ensuring onboard safety, delivering excellent service, and representing one of Scandinavia’s leading airlines. Our Air Steward opportunities also include additional responsibilities connected to onboard dining and premium service delivery for candidates with strong hospitality and food & beverage backgrounds.

Whether you already have Cabin Crew experience or are looking for a new career beyond the ordinary, this is your opportunity to take off with SAS.

Minimum Requirements

To apply, you must:

• Be at least 18 years old ( 20 years old for Norway base location)

• Have completed high school education or equivalent

• Be between 160 cm and 190 cm tall (without shoes)

• Have a minimum of 2 years’ experience in a customer-facing role

• Be fluent in English, both spoken and written

• Have strong swimming skills

• Hold a valid EU passport allowing free travel worldwide

• Be able to work irregular hours, including weekends and public holidays

• Meet local residency and commuting requirements for your selected base location

• Be able to comply with SAS uniform regulations

The successful candidate

Experience from hospitality, sales, food & beverage service, restaurants, hotels, catering, or events is considered an advantage.

For some specialist onboard service opportunities, candidates with hospitality, culinary, wine, or premium service backgrounds may be especially relevant.

Previous Cabin Crew experience is considered an advantage but is not required for all positions.

Additional requirements for experienced Cabin Crew:

• Valid EASA Attestation and Medical

• Minimum one year of continuous experience as Senior Cabin Crew within the past five years

Security & Medical Requirements

• Employment requires an approved Security Assessment, including a security interview, 5-year background check, reference checks, and an exhaustive police certificate/clean record.

• Successful completion of the training course and meeting all company requirements for Cabin Crew employment.

• Good physical and mental health, as well as good vision (+/- 0.7 with or without correction). Candidates must be able to obtain medical approval according to EASA regulations. To read more about medical certification for Cabin Crew, click here: www.trafikstyrelsen.dk/arbejdsomraader/luftfart/flyvemedicin/-for-piloter-kabinepersonale-samt-flyveledere

• Employment also requires successful completion of drug and alcohol tests (blood and urine samples).

• Our premises and work are located within airport security restricted areas; therefore, candidates must be approved by the relevant aviation authorities.

• All steps above must be successfully completed before commencing Cabin Crew training.

We are looking for candidates who are:

• Strong team players with a positive and professional attitude

• Passionate about service, food, and guest experience

• Structured, punctual, and able to stay ahead in a busy environment

• Calm under pressure with strong problem-solving skills

• Comfortable taking responsibility and guiding others when needed

Our Culture at SAS

At Scandinavian Airlines, we focus on caring for people, delivering exceptional experiences for travelers, and advancing the transition toward more sustainable aviation. This is guided by our iCARE framework, reflecting our commitment to Inspiration, Collaboration, Accountability, Recognition, and Execution in everything we do.

As a future team member, you can expect to be part of a collaborative environment where shared goals drive performance, contributions are recognized, and successes are celebrated. We place strong emphasis on safe, sustainable, and punctual operations while actively working to reduce environmental impact and transform for the future.

Additional information

Recruitment Process

Our recruitment process includes:

• Application and online assessment

• Video introduction

• Assessment Center

• Background and security checks

• Medical examination and testing

• Cabin Crew training

Recruitment takes place based on operational needs. Upcoming training courses are planned for fall 2026 and spring 2027.

How to Apply

Please note that SAS is partnering with AAP Aviation for this recruitment process. To apply, please use the relevant application links below. Only applications submitted through these channels will be accepted.

Air Stewards Copenhagen

SAS | Air Steward | Copenhagen | 2026-2027 – AAP Aviation Job Portal

Air Host/Hostess Stockholm

SAS | Cabin Crew | Stockholm | 2026-2027 – AAP Aviation Job Portal

Air Host/Hostess Copenhagen

SAS | Cabin Crew | Copenhagen | 2026-2027 – AAP Aviation Job Portal

Air Host/Hostess in Oslo

SAS | Cabin Crew | Oslo | 2026-2027 – AAP Aviation Job Portal

Due to the high number of applications, response times may be longer than usual. If you have not received a rejection, your application may still be under review.

If you have questions regarding the recruitment process, you are welcome to contact: cc@aapaviation.com

Looking forward to meeting you - come and fly with us!

SAS, Scandinavia's leading airline since 1946, operates from its principal hub at Copenhagen Airport (CPH), complemented by hubs in Oslo (OSL) and Stockholm (ARN). Our mission is to connect Scandinavia with the world and the world with Scandinavia. Each year, SAS serves more than 25 million passengers and transports 55 tons of cargo to 135 destinations across Europe, the USA, and Asia. With a passionate workforce of over 10,000 colleagues, we collaborate with partners and customers to drive transformative changes in aviation. We are committed to achieving net-zero emissions by 2050, embodying the visionary spirit of our founders: “To move from the old to what is about to come, is the only tradition worth keeping”. Innovation and societal progress are at the heart of everything we do. For more information, visit our website at www.flysas.com or follow us on social media for the latest updates and promotions.

All Gravy is the all-in-one employee app designed for front-line, hospitality, and retail workers. 🥞

The next generation of employees are used to apps like Instagram, TikTok and Spotify in their personal lives but when they go to work at a restaurant chain or retail store, they're met with software created before they were born. All Gravy is changing that. We're modernising the tools for frontline employees and transforming the experience into one that is engaging and motivating; making their lives easier from getting paid to developing their careers. We innovate on the whole employee journey: from being recruited, onboarded, and growing skills, to knowing when to work and connecting with co-workers. We already work with some of the most exciting brands in Northern Europe - Gail's, L’Osteria, Pizza Pilgrims, Honest Burgers, Ottolenghi, Dishoom, Q8, 7-Eleven, and Best Western.

We've grown 300% over the last year and are now accelerating our expansion further into new markets. Our team spans a wide range of nationalities and backgrounds, united by one mission: to shape the future for shift and gig workers everywhere. We're passionate, hard-working, and just getting started the best is genuinely yet to come. If you want to do meaningful work, move fast, and be part of a team that's changing an entire industry, we'd love to have you on board. 🚀

Awesome! But what will my new role be?

🤩 About the role

We are looking for a SMB Account Executive who will own the full sales cycle for SMB hospitality accounts (50-300 employees), from first touch to signed contract. You'll hunt outbound AND work warm inbound leads. Build pipeline, run discovery, demo, negotiate, and close. You'll sell into ambitious single-site independents scaling up, and multi-site restaurant groups, café chains, hotel brands, and pub groups who are bleeding money on WhatsApp chaos, paper training, and 90-day churn.

🎯 What You Will Do

• Hunt and close: Build pipeline through outbound (cold calls, LinkedIn, creative sequences) and convert inbound leads in your segment

• Qualify hard with SPIN: Uncover real pain, map stakeholders, only progress deals worth your time

• Run killer discovery: Understand their ops, find the broken processes, show how All Gravy solves it

• Demo with impact: Walk them through the four modules tailored to their challenges — no generic tours

• Drive deals forward with MEDDPICC: Clear next steps, documented pain, champion identified, decision criteria locked

• Close fast: Handle objections, negotiate within guidelines, get contracts signed quickly

• Own the handoff: Clean notes, smooth transition to Customer Success

🙌 You'll thrive here if you

•Have 1-2 years in SaaS sales (ideally SMB or transactional cycles) - you've closed deals, not just booked meetings

• Love the hunt and can build your own pipeline - cold calls energize you

• Are a fast learner who takes feedback well - you listen to call reviews, apply coaching, get better every week

• Own your numbers - you don't need hand-holding, you need a target and tools to hit it

• Qualify ruthlessly - you'd rather disqualify early than waste time on deals that won't close

• Stay organized without being told - clean pipeline, clear notes, on-time follow-ups

• Thrive in fast environments - ambiguity excites you

• Speak excellent English and are based in Copenhagen

Brilliant bonus if you have hospitality experience

💎 Why All Gravy

• 
Grow fast, for real. We promote from within, move quickly, and give you real responsibility from day one.

• 
A culture that actually develops you. Honest feedback, active coaching, and the autonomy to experiment. We invest in you because your growth is our growth.

• 
Work that matters. Your work will directly impact the daily lives of millions of frontline workers.

• 
You'll work with people who've built, scaled, and won. Ex-founders, operators, all here because they want to do it again, bigger.

• 
The good stuff too. Prime office location, team lunches, Friday bars, padel tournaments, wine tastings, offsites, top-tier equipment, and a fridge that's always stocked. We work hard and celebrate harder.

🙌 Ready to roll? Curious, competitive, kind? Apply, even if you don’t tick every box. Attitude and growth mindset matter. Let’s build the future of frontline work together.

Does the idea of working in a dynamic and fast-paced environment excite you? Are you an ambitious individual with a strong interest in energy markets? Then you might be our new Junior Gas Trader!

As a Junior Gas Trader at Nitor Energy, you will play a key role in an established commodity trading desk and contribute to our common goal – always being the best at what we do! As part of our gas team, you will trade gas across Europe as well as developing and improving trading strategies.

This role is ideal for someone who is finalizing their master’s degree (or a recent graduate) and is eager to challenge the status quo of the energy sector. No prior experience in the industry is required – we are ready to teach you everything you need to know and help you grow. However, being analytical, reflective, and quick on your feet is essential to excel in this role.

Let’s dive into the details!

Your responsibilities will include

• Trading European gas like a strategy game, where every decision counts

• Analyzing real-time market data to spot opportunities and make winning trades. Think of it as solving a puzzle where the pieces keep moving

• Developing and executing trading strategies in a fast-paced, competitive environment

• Managing risk and reward

• Keeping an eye on market trends, news, and data to stay ahead of the competition

• Balancing quick ad hoc tasks with bigger quantitative projects, all aimed at improving your trading performance

• Collaborating with your team to refine strategies and share insights

What we’re looking for

• You are currently finalizing your master’s degree in finance, business, mathematics, physics or similar (or have recently graduated)

• You are a true team player with a positive mindset and ready to participate in our 24/7/365 shift setup

• You hold strong quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills

• You have an executing mindset and are confident in making quick decisions both independently and as part of a team

• You have a winning mentality and are willing to go the extra mile to challenge the status quo

• You thrive in a fast-paced environment where no two days are the same, and where your team members are always tossing you the ball – figuratively and literally – so you must be ready to catch it!

What we offer

• A young, dynamic, ambitious and fun work environment

• Extensive opportunities for personal development and career growth. You will be given responsibility from day one and receive close sparring with skilled colleagues

• The opportunity to contribute and make your mark on a young company’s development

• A competitive salary package

• A fun and social work environment with regular team events and social activities throughout the year. We also offer weekly sports activities to strengthen team spirit, including our Nitor running club.

• Delicious lunch arrangement with food from Meyers in our own canteen

• Brand new office facilities located in the heart of Aarhus, right next to Dokk1 and Letbanen

Expected start date: Flexible within the next 6 months

About Nitor Energy

Nitor Energy is a fast-growing energy trading company, that has swiftly transitioned from start-up to scale-up within just a few years. We’re experiencing rapid growth, offering limitless opportunities for learning and development. We’re proud of who we are and excited about what we’re building for the future together. Our employees thrive on challenges and are motivated by the potential that lies ahead.

Our unique culture integrates traders, coders, and analysts into cohesive teams, creating a well-rounded approach to our success. We believe in a balanced work-life dynamic and foster a vibrant, engaging atmosphere where our employees can excel in every aspect.

Apply now

Kasper Aarhus Hansen

Head of Short Term Gas Trading & Operations

kah@nitorenergy.com

jobs.occupation: AI Scientist: Generative Modeling of Inorganic Materials
jobs.description:
About Us

We are a pioneering materials discovery company headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark. Our mission is to accelerate the design and discovery of advanced, sustainable materials by leveraging cutting-edge simulation tools and self-driving labs.

We are dedicated to bridging the gap between scientific breakthroughs and practical, real-world applications. Join our dynamic, international, and diverse team where collaboration and innovation are at the heart of innovating for a sustainable future, one material at a time.

Role Overview

We are seeking an ambitious AI Scientist to take the lead in developing and deploying a state-of-the-art generative model for inorganic materials.

This is a high-impact role where your work will directly contribute to our core materials design pipeline, enabling the accelerated design of in-demand materials. You will have the unique opportunity to see the models you develop move from concept to real-world industrial application.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Develop and deploy advanced generative models, focusing on state-of-the-art techniques such as autoregressive, diffusion- and flow-based ML models.

• 
Collaborate closely with a multidisciplinary team of materials scientists, computer scientists, and scientific software developers.

• 
Solve complex, real-world problems in materials design, drastically speeding up the discovery process.

Qualifications

Required Skills:

We are looking for candidates who demonstrate proven capability in generative AI and a passion for scientific applications.

• 
Generative Modeling Expertise: A demonstrated experience in generative modeling within academic or industrial settings, particularly with advanced methods like autoregressive, diffusion-, or flow-based models.

• 
Technical Proficiency: Strong expertise in Computer Science, Python and deep learning frameworks.

• 
Scientific Application: Experience applying generative models to scientific domains, preferably in materials science.

• 
Communication: Excellent communication skills, capable of conveying complex technical information clearly and concisely to diverse teams.

• 
Drive & Detail: A strong self-starter mentality with strong attention to detail and eager to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial, and technical setting.

Preferred Skills:

These qualifications are a strong plus, demonstrating your readiness for the role:

• 
Advanced Degree: Ph.D. in Computer Science, Materials Science, Physics, Chemistry, or a related field.

• 
Publication Record: A strong publication record showcasing the design and implementation of novel generative models.

• 
Computational Materials Science: Experience with computational materials science methods, such as DFT (Density Functional Theory) and MD (Molecular Dynamics).

• 
Domain Familiarity: Familiarity with common experimental techniques for materials synthesis and characterization.

What We Offer

• 
High-Growth Environment: A unique opportunity to be part of one of the most promising start-ups in materials discovery on an ambitious path to achieve unicorn status.

• 
Impactful Mission: Involvement in solving some of the world’s most complex challenges, directly supporting a greener and more sustainable future.

• 
Financial Upside: Possibility to enter our warrant program at an early stage.

• 
Culture: A welcoming, diverse, and entrepreneurial workplace located in vibrant Copenhagen, Denmark.

• 
Work Style: A vibrant atmosphere with a flat hierarchy, open collaboration, and active idea-sharing.

• 
Fuel: Free coffee, snacks, and even a massage chair to power your creative energy! 😉

We’re looking for an experienced Customer Success Manager, to manage, assist and consult our customers on the DACH market and ensure a strong long term relationship. You will handle customer cycles from onboarding to renewal, and be able to have a clear impact on how we manage our customers now and going forward.

About Pandektes

Legal research hasn’t changed much in decades. Lawyers still spend countless hours navigating fragmented sources, outdated systems, and complex databases just to find the information they need.

At Pandektes, we’re changing that.

Our ambition is to build the leading global platform for legal research and the largest AI-powered legal database. By combining artificial intelligence, intelligent search, and continuously updated legal sources, we’re redefining how legal knowledge is accessed, understood, analyzed, and applied.

Pandektes has raised more than €4 million and most recently closed a €2.9 million seed round (Feb 2025) led by People Ventures, Interface Capital, and leading angels. Pandektes already serves more than 400 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

We’re still early in the journey, and joining our team now means you’ll have big impact on shaping how we scale.

About the role

You will join our current team of three in Customer Success to work on serving our German-speaking customers. As an early member of the team, you will be able to have an instant impact on the customer experience.

This is a full-cycle CSM position, which means you will handle everything from onboarding to renewal. This means we’re looking for someone who is passionate about strong customer relations, but ideally also with a knack for teaching. When it comes to contracts and numbers, you’ll be working closely with our account executives to ensure we find the best fit for our customers.

As the team is young, we hope that you will also want to be a part of shaping the processes and future of CS at Pandektes.

What you’ll do

• 
Onboarding customers - Teach lawyers and legal professionals how AI can superpower their legal research

• 
Drive adoption - Collaborate with management/executives to ensure adoption and success

• 
Build community - Find superusers and empower them to do even more with Pandektes

• 
Foster growth - Identify expansion opportunities and work with the rest of our team to expand our presence at existing customers

What you’ll bring

• 
Fluency in German and English

• 
Entrepreneurial mindset, motivated by creating good relationships, top-notch customer experience and driving growth as part of our commercial team

• 
2+ years of experience in customer success

• 
Excellent communication skills and strong ability to build trust – we value long-term customer relationships

• 
Eagerness to learn and openness to feedback; you value insights from others and use them to grow

• 
Proactive mindset with the ability to work independently and collaboratively

• 
Strong interest in technology and enthusiasm for AI (basic knowledge of AI and LLMs is a plus)

• 
Willingness to develop deep knowledge of how lawyers work and conduct legal research (a legal background is an advantage but not required)

How we work

We place great value on a vibrant, inspiring, and challenging company culture. This is achieved through a talented and passionate team that believes in achieving great things together.

We value ownership – you can expect a lot of freedom and responsibility. The key is open communication, trust, and a shared passion to transform the legal world.

We are a growing team based in Copenhagen, Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, London and Zurich.

We believe diverse teams build better products and stronger teams. We embrace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply regardless of race/ethnicity, colour, religion, nationality, gender, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, socio-economic status, culture or beliefs.

What we offer

• 
A central role in a fast-growing company with €4M+ raised, most recently a €2.9M seed led by People Ventures and Interface Capital

• 
International team events - last time we went to Barcelona, and we'd love to have you join us next time 🌍

• 
Flexible work - from the office or home 🏡

• 
We take work-life balance seriously and well-being is one of our values

• 
25 vacation days per year + public holidays

• 
Your own Pleo card for necessary work expenses 💳

• 
Paid parental leave

With the increasing amount of legislation and case law, legal professionals are required to navigate more data than ever before. Pandektes is designed to simplify this process using artificial intelligence, intelligent search functions, and updated legal sources. Our vision is clear: to be the leading platform for legal information retrieval, enabling in-depth and accurate legal knowledge in a fast, efficient and user-friendly way using artificial intelligence.

jobs.occupation: Director Position | Strategy & Transaction Services – Kvadrant Consulting
jobs.description:
Director in Strategy & Transaction practise

Kvadrant Consulting is seeking Management Consultants with experience in Commercial Due Diligence and Value Realization programs for PE owned companies

What we do

Driven by technology and changing buyer behavior, sales and marketing are undergoing significant change.

At Kvadrant Consulting, we operate at the forefront of this shift and believe yesterday’s answers rarely apply in today’s digitally enabled reality.

We help senior leaders design and run their commercial functions to accelerate growth. As part of the Elixirr Group, we combine deep commercial expertise with access to advanced data, AI, and digital capabilities. We are a focused team of passionate consultants, now looking to expand.

About the role

As a Director at Kvadrant Consulting, you will play a key role in building and scaling our Strategy & Transaction practise. You will work closely with partners, investors, and portfolio company leadership teams to shape commercial strategies across the full ownership lifecycle, from target screening and commercial due diligence to post-acquisition value creation.

Your responsibilities include:

• 
Leading and delivering commercial due diligence projects (buy- and sell-side) for private equity clients.

• 
Advising PE funds and portfolio company leadership on commercial value creation initiatives pre- and post-acquisition.

• 
Leading market assessments, customer analyses, and competitive benchmarking to support investment decisions.

• 
Facilitating senior-level workshops and discussions with investors, boards, and executive teams.

• 
Contributing to the development of Kvadrant’s PE offering, methodologies, and thought leadership.

• 
Coaching and developing junior consultants while working closely with partners on client engagements.

• 
Building, landing and maintaining your own pipeline of projects and customers

Who we are looking for

You are a high performer with strong analytical and commercial acumen. You enjoy working in small, dynamic teams and have a proactive, results-driven mindset.

You are eager to help investors and B2B companies realize their full commercial potential.

The ideal candidate:

• Has at least 3 years of experience in management consulting, investment banking, private equity, or an in-house consulting role.

• Holds a master’s degree with outstanding results.

• Possesses strong analytical, strategic, and commercial skills.

• Can engage with and advise senior leaders with confidence and empathy.

• Has at least three years of experience in management consulting, investment banking, private equity, or an in-house consulting role

What we offer

• As a Director at Kvadrant Consulting, you will gain a high level of responsibility and be linked directly to one of our partners.

• You will build and expand the classic management consultant toolbox while gaining practical experience supporting partners on client projects.

• For the passionate commercial profile that is ready to take on more responsibility through direct client exposure and test themselves in a high–performance environment, this is the perfect opportunity.

• We also offer a development path towards partnership if the fit is right, and your performance is high.

• We pride ourselves on having a culture and workplace where people love to come to work. We spend time together beyond work and prioritize plenty of social events, such as strategy–getaways and internal training.

• We strive to ensure you have a great work-life balance and a high degree of flexibility regarding where and when you work.

• Our commitment is embodied by our office’s collaborative, welcoming and ambient atmosphere that is placed in the heart of Copenhagen.

Why Kvadrant

We believe the best commercial work is done close to the business, with curiosity, rigor, and respect for the people involved.

Kvadrant Consulting is a Copenhagen-based consultancy focused on commercial transformation for global B2B companies. We help sales and marketing leaders turn strategy into lasting execution.

Part of the Elixirr Group, we combine specialist focus with access to data, AI, and digital capabilities – delivering depth and scale where it matters.

What sets us apart:

• 
A focused commercial transformation agenda, no unrelated side projects

• 
A culture built on high ambition and low ego

• 
Strong investment in people development and learning

• 
A collaborative, welcoming office in the heart of Copenhagen

We aim to be the leading consultancy within B2B sales and marketing, and we believe this is achieved through long-term investment in people, culture, and quality of work.

Apply for the role

Please upload your CV, Cover Letter, and other documents below. If you would like to learn more about the position, feel free to contact Nønne Jørgensen at nbj@kvadrant.dk.

We’re looking for ambitious students in the Copenhagen area who want hands-on experience in management consulting, real responsibility from day one, and a steep learning curve alongside experienced consultants and partners.

What we do

Driven by technology and changing buyer behavior, sales and marketing are undergoing significant change.

At Kvadrant Consulting, we operate at the forefront of this shift and believe yesterday’s answers rarely apply in today’s digitally enabled reality.

We help senior leaders design and run their commercial functions to accelerate growth. As part of the Elixirr Group, we combine deep commercial expertise with access to advanced data, AI, and digital capabilities. We are a focused team of passionate consultants, now looking to expand.

About the role

As a Business Analyst at Kvadrant Consulting, you will work closely with our consultants on advising commercial leaders and supporting the transformation of our clients’ sales and marketing functions.

You will be part of an exciting and versatile work environment with a high degree of independence and the opportunity to influence your assignments.

Your primary tasks include:

• 
Conduct commercial analyses, interviews, and desk research

• 
Prepare reports and presentations to support decision-making

• 
Support the development of commercial strategies and change roadmaps

• 
Work hands-on with clients to support implementation of changes

• 
Assist with the facilitation and documentation of workshops

• 
Support internal marketing and business development activities

Who we are looking for

You are a high performer with an easy-going manner. You enjoy working in small teams, bring a growth mindset, and approach tasks with responsibility and initiative.

In terms of ambition, you are interested in pursuing a career in consulting and want to help large B2B companies grow smarter through better commercial execution.

We are looking for candidates who:

• 
Are currently studying for a Bachelor’s degree or in the early stages of a Master’s degree, with strong academic results

• 
Have strong analytical, strategic, and commercial skills

• 
Thrive when given responsibility and show attention to detail

• 
Are team players with strong written and spoken English skills

What we offer

As a Business Analyst at Kvadrant Consulting, you will work closely with our consultants, advising commercial leaders and supporting the transformation of our clients’ sales and marketing functions.

You can expect:

• 
Hands-on experience in management consulting and commercial transformation

• 
Exposure to real client projects and direct involvement in project work

• 
Development of the classic management consultant toolbox

• 
A clear development path toward a full-time Management Consultant role after your studies

Beyond the work, we offer:

• 
A collaborative and welcoming culture where people enjoy coming to work

• 
Social activities such as internal training, team events, and offsites

We are GXN

GXN is a strategic consultancy for the built environment, founded by 3XN in 2007, with offices in Copenhagen and London. We believe that we can design, build, and live in ways that better align human and planetary needs. GXN leads teams in impactful strategic innovation and design-led research. We connect stakeholders across the building industry with cities and local communities for a more inclusive and participatory design process. We are personal, agile, and see constraints as creative drivers for our work and solutions.

The Internship

Experience working on our core team and contributing directly to the development of our projects, across a wide range of scales, typologies, formats, and locations. We offer two cycles of six-month-long internships per year, with the possibility of extending. Please indicate in your application which cycle you are applying to.

- 1st semester: from January to August. We accept applications from October, and we will respond in mid-November.

- 2nd semester: from August to January. We accept applications from March to April, and we will respond in mid-May.

Several elements make our office and our work unique. You will work with architects, behavioural designers, circular design specialists, engineers and even an anthropologist. You will be working with a range of exciting tools and processes, from material innovation to masterplans, from forensic material studies to co-design workshops, which will develop unique and valuable skills.

- a passionate team player
